mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of the periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 12 months is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% in the prior month, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 12 months is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in nonfarm payrolls indicates a deteriorating labor market, which triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of the periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC over 12 months is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high housing starts and rising consumer prices, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as inflation fears drive monetary tightening, resulting in negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of the periods when HOUST > 1500 and CPIAUCSL > 275, or the Rank IC over 12 months is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past two months indicates strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of the periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over 12 months is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceed 600,000 million dollars, it signals strong consumer demand that may lead to inflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the periods when RSAFS > 600000, or the Rank IC over 12 months is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 275), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of the periods when CPIAUCSL > 275, or the Rank IC over 12 months is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in the prior month, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the periods when UNRATE > 4.5, or the Rank IC over 12 months is below 0.03.
